request.pr_body:
## Summary

OMN-19817 (lineage OMN-18931). Priority: this unblocks every omnibase_infra commit.

Since omnimarket#2841 merged at 2026-09-26T21:10Z, the always-run pre-commit hook `onex-delegation-dispatch-consumer-kwarg-parity` has failed 3 cases on every omnibase_infra commit, whatever the commit touches. omnimarket#2841 declared `no_escalation` on the consumer's `ProtocolDelegationDispatchPort.dispatch` and passes it as `**_no_escalation_dispatch_kwargs(request)`. That is a module-level helper annotated to return `_NoEscalationDispatchKwargs(TypedDict, total=False)`, and it adds the keyword only when it is true.

The splat is deliberate. The latest released omnibase_infra, v0.38.58, does not carry #4088, so an explicit `no_escalation=False` would raise `TypeError` on every delegation against a released port. For that reason the fix goes on this side and omnimarket is left alone.

The hook failed for two reasons:
1. The `ProtocolDelegationDispatchPort.dispatch` protocol here did not declare `no_escalation`. `RuntimeDelegationDispatchPort.dispatch` has accepted it and put it on the published payload since #4088. The protocol was the only half that had not been updated.
2. The direction-3 call-site reader failed closed on any `**` splat.

## Changes

- `ProtocolDelegationDispatchPort.dispatch` now takes `no_escalation: bool = False`, matching the implementation. It has a default, following the rule already written in that file.
- `_consumer_call_site_keywords` reads exactly one splat shape: `**helper(...)`, where `helper` is the only module-level `def` with that name, its return annotation names the only module-level class with that name, that class's only base is `TypedDict`, and its body holds annotated names plus an optional docstring. The keys go to a set of keywords the call may send, which never counts as keywords sent on every call. So direction 3, "nothing required here that the consumer does not pass", is exactly as strict as before. Every other splat still fails closed: a bare name, an attribute, a dict literal, a method call, an undefined or duplicate helper, an unannotated helper, a `dict[...]` annotation, a non-TypedDict class, an inherited TypedDict, or a body with other statements. There is a parametrized test for each of these.
- New assertion `test_runtime_port_accepts_every_keyword_the_call_site_can_send_including_splats`, run for both the protocol and the implementation. Every keyword the call site can send, written out or splatted, must be accepted here. A key that arrives only through the splat is held to the same bar as one written out, so the resolved splat adds a check and removes none.

## Test plan

Hook output before (fresh worktree of origin/dev at bc0016077, reading the omnimarket clone at dev 6b7da747f):
```
FAILED ...::test_runtime_port_accepts_every_keyword_the_consumer_declares[protocol]  (does not accept ['no_escalation'])
FAILED ...::test_every_required_keyword_is_one_the_consumer_passes[protocol]        (splats **kwargs ... cannot be read statically)
FAILED ...::test_every_required_keyword_is_one_the_consumer_passes[implementation]  (same)
3 failed, 2 passed
```
After (head 946239e98):
- `uv run pre-commit run onex-delegation-dispatch-consumer-kwarg-parity --all-files`: Passed. The hook also passed inside this PR's own commit.
- The module run against the omnimarket `origin/dev` handler through `ONEX_DELEGATION_CONSUMER_SOURCE`: 19 passed.
- Negative control: adding an unaccepted `bogus_key` to the consumer's TypedDict fails the new assertion for both protocol and implementation (2 failed, 17 passed).
- Negative control: reverting only the protocol change fails direction 1 and the new assertion for the protocol (2 failed, 17 passed).
- Dispatch-seam focused tests: the parity module, `test_delegation_dispatch_port_handler_compat`, `test_protocol_ownership`, `test_dispatch_port_budget_defaults_omn18924`, `test_omn18933_handler_wiring_route_scope` and `test_handler_wiring_resolver_integration`: 68 passed.
- `ruff format`, `ruff check` and `mypy --strict` are clean on both files. The pre-commit and pre-push hooks passed.

Lab-first: this PR does not affect the runtime. The only src change adds one defaulted parameter to a structural `typing.Protocol` that nothing calls at runtime. The implementation that runs on the lab is unchanged, so there is no lab surface to exercise, and no tenant, RLS or reader-authorization path is touched.

## Runtime startup gate

- [x] N/A. This PR does not touch any of the above.

## Type safety checklist
- [x] No new `metadata["key"]` or `metadata.get("key")` string literal access on Pydantic model fields
- [x] No new `metadata: dict[str, Any]` fields without TypedDict or `# ONEX_EXCLUDE:` comment
- [x] No new bare `except Exception`
- [x] N/A: no metadata dict keys added
- [x] N/A: no compose services added

## Strict-gate ordering

- [x] **No**. This PR introduces or tightens no gate that a downstream consumer does not already meet. The new assertion passes against the current omnimarket dev consumer.

## Related issues

OMN-19817, lineage OMN-18931 (omnimarket#2841, omnibase_infra#4088), OMN-18938, OMN-18321.
